title: Projection iteration on encoded words
statement: For any finite list $L$ of bit strings and natural number $j$, applying the total second projection $j$ times to the concatenation of the encodings $\langle w,[]\rangle$ for $w$ in $L$ gives the corresponding concatenation for the list obtained by removing the first $j$ entries of $L$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list $L$ of bit strings
